claim: The first time Amazon Macie is enabled, the account is automatically enrolled in a 30-day free trial, including individual member accounts of an AWS Organizations organization; the trial runs for 30 consecutive days and cannot be paused.
question: How long is the Amazon Macie free trial, and can it be paused?
q: docs/macie/latest/user/account-mgmt-free-trial

When you enable Amazon Macie for the first time, your AWS account is automatically enrolled in the 30-day free trial of Macie. This includes individual member accounts in an AWS Organizations organization.
docs/macie/latest/user/account-mgmt-free-trial
The free trial runs for 30 consecutive days. You can’t pause it after it starts.

claim: The Macie free trial covers preventative control monitoring (bucket inventory and evaluation) and automated sensitive data discovery, but not sensitive data discovery jobs; jobs that analyze more than 1 GB of uncompressed data during the trial incur charges.
question: Are Macie sensitive data discovery jobs included in the free trial?
q: docs/macie/latest/user/account-mgmt-free-trial

The free trial doesn’t include analysis of S3 objects by sensitive data discovery jobs. You’ll incur charges if you create and run sensitive data discovery jobs that analyze more than 1 GB of uncompressed data during the free trial.

claim: Macie has a monthly free tier for sensitive data discovery: each month there is no charge to analyze up to 1 GB of uncompressed data in S3 objects.
question: How much data can Macie analyze each month at no charge?

values.display: up to 1 GB of uncompressed data
values.spoken: up to one gigabyte of uncompressed data

q: docs/macie/latest/user/account-mgmt-free-trial
Each month, there’s no charge to analyze up to 1 GB of uncompressed data in S3 objects.

claim: During the Macie free trial, object analysis by automated sensitive data discovery pauses after 150 GB of uncompressed data has been analyzed for an account, and resumes after the trial ends.
question: How much data does Macie automated discovery analyze during the free trial?

qualifiers.scope: per account enrolled in the free trial

q: docs/macie/latest/user/account-mgmt-free-trial

This is because object analysis by automated sensitive data discovery is paused when 150 GB of uncompressed data has been analyzed for an account that's enrolled in the free trial. Object analysis resumes for the account after the free trial ends.

claim: The Macie console Usage page shows the remaining days of the free trial and a breakdown of estimated usage costs in US dollars.
question: Where do you see Macie's remaining free trial days and estimated costs?
q: docs/macie/latest/user/account-mgmt-free-trial
The **Usage** page indicates the number of remaining days in your free trial. It also shows a breakdown of your estimated usage costs in US dollars (USD):

claim: Macie charges on three dimensions: the number of S3 buckets evaluated for bucket inventory and monitoring, the number of S3 objects monitored for automated data discovery, and the quantity of data inspected for automated and targeted sensitive data discovery.
question: What are the Amazon Macie pricing dimensions?
q: www/macie/pricing

With Macie, you are charged based on three dimensions: the number of Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) buckets evaluated for bucket inventory and monitoring, the number of Amazon S3 objects monitored for automated data discovery, and the quantity of data inspected for automated and targeted sensitive data discovery.

claim: The Macie 30-day free trial includes automated data discovery, inspecting up to 150GB per account, and 30 days of bucket inventory and monitoring; every newly enabled account gets it, even in multi-account setups.
question: How much data does the Macie free trial inspect per account?

values.spoken: up to one hundred fifty gigabytes per account

q: www/macie/pricing

Macie inspects up to 150GB per account within the free trial period. The free-trial also includes 30-days of bucket inventory and monitoring. Each new account that is enabled with Macie receives this free trial period, even in multi-account configurations.

claim: A Macie account can have up to 1,000 filter rules and suppression rules, and each sensitive data finding reports up to 15 detection locations.
question: How many filter and suppression rules can a Macie account have?
q: docs/macie/latest/user/macie-quotas

Filter rules and suppression rules per account: 1,000
+ Findings per run of a sensitive data discovery job: 100,000 \+ 5% of any remaining findings after the 100,000 threshold is met
docs/macie/latest/user/macie-quotas

Detection locations per sensitive data finding: 15
+ Requests to retrieve and reveal sensitive data samples from an Amazon S3 object: 100 per day

note: d061. Adjustable not stated per quota on the page; set false.

claim: Macie performs preventative control monitoring for up to 10,000 S3 buckets per account; above that, only the 10,000 most recently created or changed buckets get full monitoring.
question: How many S3 buckets per account does Macie fully monitor for security and access control?
q: docs/macie/latest/user/macie-quotas
If your account exceeds this quota, Macie provides full monitoring functionality for the 10,000 buckets that were most recently created or changed.

claim: Macie sensitive data discovery jobs can analyze up to 5 TB per account per month by default; the quota applies only to discovery jobs.
question: How much data can Macie discovery jobs analyze per account per month by default?
q: docs/macie/latest/user/macie-quotas

Monthly analysis per account by sensitive data discovery jobs: 5 TB

  This quota applies only to sensitive data discovery jobs.
note: d061. The page says it can be raised through Service Quotas (to as much as 1,000 TB); that sentence holds a link and is not quoted.

claim: A Macie account can have up to 10,000 custom data identifiers, and a single sensitive data discovery job can use up to 30 of them.
question: How many custom data identifiers can a Macie account have, and how many per job?

qualifiers.scope: per account; per sensitive data discovery job

q: docs/macie/latest/user/macie-quotas

Custom data identifiers per account: 10,000
+ Allow lists per account: 10, 1–5 allow lists that specify predefined text and 1–5 allow lists that specify regular expressions
docs/macie/latest/user/macie-quotas
Custom data identifiers per sensitive data discovery job: 30

claim: A Macie account can have up to 10 allow lists: 1 to 5 that specify predefined text and 1 to 5 that specify regular expressions.
question: How many allow lists can a Macie account have?
q: docs/macie/latest/user/macie-quotas

Custom data identifiers per account: 10,000
+ Allow lists per account: 10, 1–5 allow lists that specify predefined text and 1–5 allow lists that specify regular expressions

claim: A Macie sensitive data discovery job that analyzes specific selected buckets can include up to 1,000 S3 buckets; the quota does not apply to jobs that use runtime bucket criteria.
question: How many specific S3 buckets can one Macie discovery job analyze?

qualifiers.condition: jobs that analyze specific selected buckets

q: docs/macie/latest/user/macie-quotas

S3 buckets per sensitive data discovery job: 1,000

  This quota doesn't apply to jobs that use runtime bucket criteria to determine which buckets to analyze.

claim: Macie spends at most 10 hours analyzing an individual file in a sensitive data discovery job, and it does not analyze any data in a file that is larger than the size quota for its type.
question: What is the maximum time Macie spends analyzing one file?
q: docs/macie/latest/user/macie-quotas

Time to analyze an individual file: 10 hours
+ Size of an individual file to analyze:
docs/macie/latest/user/macie-quotas
If a file is larger than the applicable quota, Macie doesn't analyze any data in the file.

note: d061. Per-type file size quotas range from 512 MB (Office files) to 20 GB (text, TAR, .eml).
